newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit falls against dollar on offshore selling.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit falls against dollar on offshore selling.

text.p: * Ringgit falls on offshore selling but covering by local players limits drop
* More selling expected during European trading
The ringgit fell against the dollar on offshore selling but covering by local players limited the drop, dealers said.
"Sydney bought up dollar/ringgit to around 2.5160 this morning but it fell back when Malaysian trading started," said a dealer at a Malaysian bank.
Dealers said the ringgit could see fresh selling in London later in the day. "There has been a lot of selling out of London and the ringgit could again head for 2.5200," said a European bank dealer.
But fears of Bank Negara intervention should cap the dollar/ringgit at 2.5200, he said.
The central bank was rumoured to be checking rates at 2.5190/95 a dollar on Wednesday.
At 0130 GMT, ringgit was quoted at 2.5140/50 a dollar against 2.5117/27 at the close of Kuala Lumpur on Friday.
